title: Kelowna Guided Hiking Experience
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Experience the best Kelowna Guided Hiking in the city! Get ready to take in the views and get your heart pumping as we explore the wilderness, forests and waterfalls that make hiking around Kelowna so popular.

This all inclusive adventure includes round trip transportation from your Kelowna accommodation, guide, access to an iconic Kelowna hiking trail and a light lunch.

Throughout your Kelowna Hiking, you’ll learn about the local ecology and history of the Okanagan Valley as you enjoy incredible views. All Kelowna Guided Hiking Tours are 6 hours including pick up and drop off. Trail lengths average between 9.2 and 10.3 km in total.

Our Kelowna Guided Hiking visits the most popular and scenic trails daily! All trails are classified as easy to moderate, ensuring accessibility for all ages and abilities. Trails that we visit include one of the following (selected by the Vivid Tours team): Angel Springs Via KLO Creek, Wildhorse Canyon North Loop and Goode’s Basin Trail.
